body:
Track 6 follow-up to `garment-twonodeoptics` (its next step: compare optics effects at steady state). Adds a `minutes` argument to `flex.run` (default unchanged) and a new project that runs the same scenarios for 60 min and 24 h of model time.

Result (stylised, model only): three of four scenarios are already steady at one hour; in the 16 C room the ref/ours disagreement in dry-loss effects shrinks from 1.9–2.7 to 0.89–0.98 at steady state.

Checks: 9 new tests pass, 31 existing `garment-twonodeoptics` tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
